description: This is a Java source file defining a page object class for Selenium WebDriver tests related to the login page of OrangeHRM application. It provides methods to open the login page and perform login actions.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: A minimal page object representing the login page, allowing navigation and login automation for tests.

methods.name: LoginPage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LoginPage with a WebDriver instance.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Navigates the WebDriver to the specified base URL, opening the login page.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login action by entering username and password, then clicking the submit button.
